integrity: The theorem has an explicit argument for arbitrary finite size; numerical eigenspace tests check small sizes only. General DFS conditions and the all-site Haken–Strobl model are prior literature, not claims of novelty here.
scientific_limitations: Adjacency Hamiltonian on a finite open path and strictly positive, time-independent pure-dephasing site rates; no disorder, absorption, changing rates or spectral-gap lower bound. All-state limit has coherent oscillations if the protected dimension is at least two. Priority is not independently established.
title: Arithmetic protected coherence under sparse dephasing on a finite quantum path
